observations: Two black, rectangular power banks lying on a concrete floor.
The top unit has a large piece of yellowish tape covering the front surface.
The bottom unit has a visible black label on the side, but the text is illegible.
Both units have green and blue braided cables attached.
The units appear to be made of plastic with a matte finish.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are visible on either unit.

claims.evidence: The items appear to be used and taped, but there is no visual proof of their internal battery health or capacity.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be degraded or dead, making it unable to charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the power bank charging a phone or a multimeter reading the battery voltage.

risks.risk: The capacity (mAh) is unknown, which is the primary factor in determining value.
risks.proof: A photo of the specification label on the side of the bottom unit.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest capacity common for this form factor

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the specification label on the bottom power bank showing the capacity (mAh) and voltage.
Video of the power bank charging a mobile device to verify functionality.
Photo of the cables and any ports to check for damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
